why: The P7 task specifies previews at 960x540, 12 fps, lite FX. 12 is an exact divisor of the ADR-002 F24 film rate, so every preview frame is a film frame and anchor frames halve exactly (no rounding drift between preview and final); 15 fps (tokens.ts, 03 P7.3/P9.1) resamples 24 -> 15 with up to 1/2 frame of rounding. SpecPlayer uses PREVIEW_FPS = 12 (src/spec/resolve.ts); `dc render spec <id> --fps 15` reproduces the token value. Width, height and tier still come from the frozen PREVIEW token.
